# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 1
English level: upper

Hello!

I have one year of practical experience as a Python Developer and Data Engineer and over 4 years running my own business.



I build web applications and RESTful APIs using Django and Django REST Framework. I use PostgreSQL, Git, and Docker. I also have experience in FastAP. In my projects, I worked with Telegram Bot API and Celery task frameworks.



My mathematical education and my Pandas, Matplotlib, and SQL knowledge allow me to query and manipulate data effectively to extract valuable insights and approach problems with a logical and analytical mindset. 



Additionally, my experience running my own business has provided me with valuable skills such as project management, client communication, and problem-solving. I am able to work independently or as part of a team and can prioritize tasks to meet deadlines. 



With my Upper Intermediate English proficiency, I can communicate effectively with clients and colleagues from diverse backgrounds.

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

# Resume

Python Developer
Years of experience: 3
English level: upper

Designed and developed a system that allowed to create of unique customer accounts among 30m of users with non-unique phone numbers. The system was scalable and configurable with abilities to adjust infrastructure load, trace, repeat, and roll back each step of every migration.



Designed and developed a system that gathers data about more than 3 million SEO-important pages, calculates their score, and ranks them.



Seamlessly upgraded project ElasticSearch from 2.X to 6.X



Constantly worked on performance. Our team reduced the number of slow SQL queries from 25/s to 0.1-0.3/s. One of my achievements was decreasing 95th percentile of chat API response time from 1.5s to 50ms.
I'm a backend-oriented software engineer with 3 years of commercial experience (e-commerce domain). Have bachelor degree in Computer Science. Have experience working both with large-scale monolithic apps and developing microservices from scratch.



The project I'm currently working on is a big (10k RPS peak load) goods marketplace. It consists of a monolith written in Python and a bunch of microservices written in Python/Node/Go/etc. I'm working on:

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

Front-end is acceptable but should be a minor part of the job. 

No Python 2.X

- Optimizing SQL functions and stored procedures

- Worked with Agile methodologies

- Worked on AWS cloud provider

- Developing algorithms to process data

Not healthcare and life science

 Remote

 Part-time job ~ 20h per week

 Any responsibilities within Product and IT Project Management as long as it is fits available timeframes

resume_parser.markdown:
# Resume

QA Engineer
Years of experience: 3
English level: fluent

Improved the development process on the project by integrating metrics 



Conducting analytics using metrics, requirements, and metrics-based metrics - was able to improve the process on the project



Conduct security testing on several projects successfully 



Automated smoke/regression tests on projects



Onboarding of new specialists in the company 



Management of several QA Engieers teams



Mentoring of QA Engineer 



Writing documentation for other QAs (Personal Development Plan)
Good day! 

I am a QA Engineer with over 3 years of experience in QA testing. 

Can bring my expertise and passion for ensuring top-notch software performance. Get ready to elevate your product experience with my skills and dedication.

My qualifications and experience include: 

 - carrying out test cases, scripts, plans, and procedures for testing projects in previous roles

 - identifying, documenting, and tracking bugs and errors

 - working closely with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues

 - collaborating with various stakeholders to deliver high-quality software products

 - proficiency in automated testing tools such as Selenium and expertise in both web and mobile app testing

 - problem-solving and analytical skills, coupled with keen attention to detail

 - working across various industries like Healthcare, Food Ordering and Transportation

 - excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 - staying up-to-date with industry trends, technologies, and best practices in QA testing

In terms of tools, I will use:

 - Selenium to streamline and accelerate the testing process.

 - a combination of web and mobile app testing techniques to ensure optimal performance across various platforms

 - standard software QA methodologies, tools, and processes to maintain consistency and efficiency in testing procedures



I can proudly say that I have extensive experience in the manual part of QA Engineering. On various projects, I have worked with certain tools for product testing such as:



Automation and API testing: UI Automation, cypress.io, nightwatch.js, Postman, Fiddler

Performance testing: Apache JMeter 

SQL and Databases: MySQL, MongoDB

Bug Tracking Systems: Jira, Confluence, Monday QAse

Security testing: OWASP ZAP

Test Management Tools: TestRail, Bugzilla

Version control tools: Git/GitHub. SourceTree. Azure devops, Circleci

Now the main thing for me is to practice and gain experience, so I am always happy to share my knowledge and absorb interesting design solutions from my colleagues to pump up their technical skills.



I will be glad to talk to you! :)
Professional and personal growth encouraging; Ability to work sometimes remotely.

-I dedicate my time and effort to creating an informative Telegram channel that will serve as a valuable source of knowledge on management.

I believe that understanding design will help me communicate better with designers and developers, which in turn will have a positive impact on project performance. In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development

 - customer cabinet

 - rating & feedback ecosystem

 - authorization

 - marketing events system



The most common technologies in my day-to-day work are:

 - Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL for backend

 - gRPC, Kafka for cross-service communications

 - Docker, Helm, Kubernetes as deployment tools

 - Git as VCS
I expect good engineering culture.

# Resume

QA Engineer
Years of experience: 3
English level: fluent

Improved the development process on the project by integrating metrics 



Conducting analytics using metrics, requirements, and metrics-based metrics - was able to improve the process on the project



Conduct security testing on several projects successfully 



Automated smoke/regression tests on projects



Onboarding of new specialists in the company 



Management of several QA Engieers teams



Mentoring of QA Engineer 



Writing documentation for other QAs (Personal Development Plan)
Good day! 

I am a QA Engineer with over 3 years of experience in QA testing. 

Can bring my expertise and passion for ensuring top-notch software performance. Get ready to elevate your product experience with my skills and dedication.

My qualifications and experience include: 

 - carrying out test cases, scripts, plans, and procedures for testing projects in previous roles

 - identifying, documenting, and tracking bugs and errors

 - working closely with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues

 - collaborating with various stakeholders to deliver high-quality software products

 - proficiency in automated testing tools such as Selenium and expertise in both web and mobile app testing

 - problem-solving and analytical skills, coupled with keen attention to detail

 - working across various industries like Healthcare, Food Ordering and Transportation

 - excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 - staying up-to-date with industry trends, technologies, and best practices in QA testing

In terms of tools, I will use:

 - Selenium to streamline and accelerate the testing process.

 - a combination of web and mobile app testing techniques to ensure optimal performance across various platforms

 - standard software QA methodologies, tools, and processes to maintain consistency and efficiency in testing procedures



I can proudly say that I have extensive experience in the manual part of QA Engineering. On various projects, I have worked with certain tools for product testing such as:



Automation and API testing: UI Automation, cypress.io, nightwatch.js, Postman, Fiddler

Performance testing: Apache JMeter 

SQL and Databases: MySQL, MongoDB

Bug Tracking Systems: Jira, Confluence, Monday QAse

Security testing: OWASP ZAP

Test Management Tools: TestRail, Bugzilla

Version control tools: Git/GitHub. SourceTree. Azure devops, Circleci

I will be glad to talk to you! :)
Professional and personal growth encouraging; Ability to work sometimes remotely.

In addition, I want to develop my product management skills to ensure effective planning and coordination of all phases of the product life cycle. My goal is to develop professionally and help the company reach new heights in the field of software development
